# Nebula Labs

> Custom software, AI agents, end-to-end automation and external CTO services, backed by a team of mathematicians and engineers. Remote-first, global.

Nebula Labs (NEBULA LABS SL, Spain) is a boutique deep-tech lab working on three fronts: services for companies, its own products, and open-source research.

## Services

- End-to-end automation: we map your processes and automate them end to end, from operations to reporting.
- Fractional CTO: technical leadership without a full-time hire: architecture, roadmap, vendors and team.
- Custom software: distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native products, built to last.
- Applied AI: LLMs, autonomous agents and MLOps, taken from prototype to production.
- Quantum computing: quantum algorithms and hybrid classical-quantum architectures, applied where they make sense.
- Technology consulting: independent technical judgment to decide what to build, buy or skip.

## Products

- AI Central: one data layer for all your business tools. It centralizes a company's software so decisions use data from all its sources.
- SLR (Systematic Literature Review): find the most relevant papers for a systematic review, following PRISMA, and download the documentation. Open source.

## Open source and research
